# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest stable version of BusyBox is supported with security updates. We encourage users to upgrade to the latest version for the best security and performance.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| v1.2.x  | :white_check_mark: |
| v1.1.x  | :white_check_mark: |
| < v1.1  | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take security seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability in this project, please report it privately.

**DO NOT** create a public issue for security vulnerabilities.

### How to Report

1.  **Email**: Send an email to [security@busy4me.com](mailto:security@busy4me.com) with details about the vulnerability.
2.  **GitHub Security Advisory**: If available, use the "Report a vulnerability" button in the Security tab of this repository.

### What to Include

Please provide as much information as possible, including:

-   A description of the vulnerability.
-   Steps to reproduce the issue.
-   Any relevant logs or screenshots.
-   Potential impact of the vulnerability.

### Response Timeline

We will acknowledge receipt of your report within 48 hours and will strive to provide a fix or workaround as soon as possible.
